mapper.sql: select lr.reader_id, lr.user_id, lr.reader_no, lr.card_no, lr.id_card, lr.borrow_limit, lr.total_borrow_count, lr.current_borrow_count, lr.status, lr.create_by, lr.create_time, lr.update_by, lr.update_time, lr.remark, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.phonenumber, u.email, u.sex, u.avatar from lib_reader lr left join sys_user u on lr.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.select:
u.del_flag = '0' and lr.reader_no like concat('%', #{readerNo}, '%') and lr.card_no like concat('%', #{cardNo}, '%') and u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') and u.nick_name like concat('%', #{nickName}, '%') and u.phonenumber like concat('%', #{phonenumber}, '%') and lr.status = #{status}
order by lr.reader_id desc
mapper.update: update lib_reader set total_borrow_count = ifnull(total_borrow_count, 0) + 1, current_borrow_count = ifnull(current_borrow_count, 0) + 1 where reader_id = #{readerId}
